Why go: a puzzle game played across an island

Most trips to Koh Tan are about snorkelling. This one turns the island into a game board: a mix of escape-room riddles, a treasure map and a beach day, played as one team. It is one of the few activities on Koh Samui that keeps teenagers and adults equally busy, and it works well for birthdays, family reunions and small company groups.

What you'll do

A minivan takes you to the beach club at Thong Krut, where the host explains the story and hands over the first riddle. A longtail takes you across to Koh Tan, a quiet, low island with a fishing village and coral reefs, where the clues lead you around beaches, paths and landmarks for about three hours. You return to Samui with the final code to open the safe, then have the option of lunch.

Who it suits

  • Families with children from 6, groups of friends and team-building groups of 4–8.
  • Repeat visitors who have already done the classic island tours.

Who should choose something else

  • If you mainly want to snorkel and see the pigs, book the Pig Island speedboat tour or a private longtail.
  • Couples on their own: the game needs at least 4 players.

Good to know

  • Sea: the crossing is short, but from October to December strong north-east winds can cancel longtail trips on some days.
  • Heat: the quest is outdoors at midday; bring water, a hat and reef-safe sunscreen.
  • Respect: Koh Tan has a small village; keep to paths and take rubbish back.

Before you book

Send us your group size, the ages of any children, your preferred date and the language you want the host to speak. We confirm the price and the date with the game team, then send a payment link. Groups larger than 8 can play together if we know in advance.
